اعتوروا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَوَرُوا (iʕtawarū) /iʕ.ta.wa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اُعْتُوِرُوا (uʕtuwirū) /uʕ.tu.wi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اِعْتَوِرُوا (iʕtawirū) /iʕ.ta.wi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
